name: Exposure Score
summary: The pack's convergence page (Nemesis). Fuses every Hound's signal into ONE exposure score per asset — KEV+EPSS+VPR+ACR+AES and open-finding SLA aging direct, plus attack path (Fenrir), identity (Janus: account reuse > other NHI / identity risk), AI (Pythia), EOL (Charon), weak/expiring crypto (Certania+Heimdall), ATT&CK (Orthrus) and ownership (Terminus) from tags. Grouped estate / convergence / confidence metrics, an at-a-glance strip and a jump nav; ranks the estate worst-first, surfaces the worst finding from each Hound and where they converge, and turns a remediation play into a projected reduction. Cached on disk per navi.db + weighting and built in the background. Priority tagging is gated and recomputed server-side.
